Real local AI path. Hospital, 5 cycles: points identical to the seed (ids, text, order) every time; 8.5–10.6 s each. Nursing Home, 5 cycles (rerun after fixing the test's end-of-save wait): text and order identical every time, but every Save Note re-issues the three point ids; 5.1–6.4 s each. Timing (record-only): 10/10 within 15 s, none over 30 s, all claude-haiku-4-5, no fallback.
Product issue: Nursing Home Save Note gives the Important Points new ids each time (the NH PreRoundTab handleProcess rebuilds the cards from the points box); text and order stay the same, so the physician sees no difference. Question for Daniela: should ids be part of the U3/T5 check for Nursing Home, given it rebuilds its cards from the points box?

descriptionHtml:
Bug B20 · excluded (All tickets still in progress / ready for PR (not counted, Quinn 2026-10-14)) · was P1

Save Note rewrites Important Points: even when the AI call fails (a point differing only in case is dropped, an unsaved draft becomes a card); Nursing Home rebuilds their ids on every save

Tickets: TFA-92590 in progress · counts as a QA bug: no (ticket in progress) · found on: local

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-12/S28

Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S19 Ten Save Note cycles with three points on the chart: timing, AI time and model logged, points unchanged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U9 Save Note timing and traceability: panels expected within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10 cycles, 30 s is the upper limit for investigation; … (UAT 3.5; UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U3 Re-saving the pre-round note with different content leaves every point untouched: Save Note never adds, edits, or removes a point. (UAT TC-12; TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes. (UAT TC-12; UAT 3.3; TFA-92590 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • T5 Points are stored exactly as typed: text, case, punctuation, symbols and spacing, one card per typed point, nothing added. Deterministic: any single mismatch fails and is quoted typed vs stored; … (TFA-92590 AC 4; TFA-92590 description) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given Hospital patient seeded with the S01 points, Nursing Home resident seeded with the S02 points

When Scripted Playwright loop: five Save Note cycles per mode, each with the next S10 (Hospital) / S11 (Nursing Home) note; time each tap on Save Note to the editor closing; read the backend after every cycle; read diagnostics:list

Then Panels within 10-15 s, 15 s or less in at least 9/10; any run over 30 s not caused by the AI service is flagged; each cycle has a pre-round parse row with model, durationMs and providerMs; the three points are identical to the seed after every cycle

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.5 targets are reported, not Pass/Fail (over-30 s runs go to review with Vikram). Timing comes from the scripted loop (click Save Note -> editor dialog hidden) and from diagnostics:list rows for the pre-round parse (parsing.parsePreRoundNotes, or the Nursing Home parse action): durationMs, providerMs and model (3.9 / 3.1), never from agent tool timestamps, which include m …

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-12.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92590 in progress

In Nursing Home every Save Note silently re-creates the three Important Points with new ids. The physician sees the same text and order, and all ten Save Notes finished within 15 s.

Evidence: allure b0a1cc04: in Hospital all 5 cycles keep ids, text and order; in NH the ids are re-issued every cycle. TC-12 matrix knownGap: 'Nursing Home Save Note rebuilds the cards from the editor box, one card per line, with new ids' (TFA-92590 in progress, Quinn's 10-09 audit). Timing is record-only: 8.5-10.6 s in Hospital, 5.1-6.4 s in NH, all Haiku, no fallback.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

Timing recorded only; points judged. — Scripted loop; points regression is deterministic.

Nursing Home, 5 cycles (rerun after fixing the test's end-of-save wait): text and order identical every time, but every Save Note re-issues the three point ids; 5.1–6.4 s each. Timing (record-only): 10/10 within 15 s, none over 30 s, all claude-haiku-4-5, no fallback.

Product issue: Nursing Home Save Note gives the Important Points new ids each time (the NH PreRoundTab handleProcess rebuilds the cards from the points box); text and order stay the same, so the physician sees no difference. Fails the oracle's 'ids, text, order' check (TC-12 U3/T5); Hospital unchanged in 5/5 cycles. Question for Daniela: should ids be part of the U3/T5 check for Nursing Home, given it rebuilds its cards from the points box?
